text:
A man carries 20 tiles from the ground to the roof of a house. Each tile has a mass of 1.2kg. The
roof of the house is 15m above the ground.
How much work does the man do against gravity on the tiles in carrying them to the roof?
A
36J
B
180J
C
360J
D
3600J
subject: Physics
